    [107778070777162] = SAE,

while gameId == 0 and game.PlaceId == 0 do
    task.wait()
    gameId = game.GameId
end

local url = byGameId[gameId] or byPlaceId[game.PlaceId]
if not url then
    return
end

    local ok, source = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)

        local chunk = loadstring(source)
        if chunk then
            chunk()
        end
        return
    end
    task.wait(0.5)
end

local environment = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G

    return

local function alreadyShown()
    if typeof(isfile) ~= "function" or typeof(readfile) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end
    local okExists, exists = pcall(isfile, SAVE_FILE)
    if not okExists or not exists then
        return false
    end
    local okRead, content = pcall(readfile, SAVE_FILE)
    return okRead and type(content) == "string" and string.find(content, INVITE_URL, 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function markShown()
    if typeof(writefile) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        if typeof(isfolder) == "function" and typeof(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(SAVE_FOLDER) then
            makefolder(SAVE_FOLDER)
        end
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
            Shown = true,
            Invite = INVITE_URL,
            ShownAt = os.time(),
        }))
    end)
end

if alreadyShown() then
    environment[LOCK_KEY] = false
    return
end
markShown()

local random = Random.new()
local CHARACTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
local function randomName()
    local length = random:NextInteger(10, 18)
    local parts = table.create(length)
    for index = 1, length do
        local pick = random:NextInteger(1, #CHARACTERS)
        parts[index] = string.sub(CHARACTERS, pick, pick)
    end
    return table.concat(parts)
end

local function resolveParent()
    if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and typeof(result) == "Instance" then
            return result
        end
    end
    return CoreGui
end

local function fontOf(family, weight, fallback)
    local ok, font = pcall(Font.new, family, weight, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    if ok and font then
        return font
    end
    return Font.fromEnum(fallback)
end
local HEAVY = fontOf("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.Font.GothamBlack)

local MONO = fontOf("rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.Font.RobotoMono)

local function create(className, properties, parent)
    local instance = Instance.new(className)
    instance.Name = randomName()
    for key, value in pairs(properties) do
        instance[key] = value
    end
    instance.Parent = parent
    return instance
end
local function round(parent, radius)
    return create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = radius }, parent)
end
local function sequence(points)
    local keypoints = {}
    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
        table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
    end
    return ColorSequence.new(keypoints)
end
local function fade(points)
    local keypoints = {}
    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
        table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
    end
    return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end
local function tween(instance, info, goal)
    local playing = TweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
    playing:Play()
    return playing
end
local function quick(seconds, style, direction, delay)
    return TweenInfo.new(seconds, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, delay or 0)
end

local function refreshFit()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    if viewport.X < 1 or viewport.Y < 1 then
        viewport = Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    end
    local scale = math.min(viewport.X * 0.6 / DESIGN_WIDTH, viewport.Y * 0.5 / DESIGN_HEIGHT, 1.15)
    fitScale.Scale = math.max(scale, 0.5)
end

local function close(immediate)
    if closed then
        return
    end
    closed = true
    if environment[LOCK_KEY] == handle then
        environment[LOCK_KEY] = false
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    table.clear(connections)
    if immediate then
        pcall(function()
            screenGui:Destroy()
        end)
        return
    end
    local out = quick(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    tween(backdrop, out, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    tween(popScale, out, { Scale = 0.9 })
    tween(card, out, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
    tween(borderStroke, out, { Transparency = 1 })
    for _, glow in ipairs(glows) do
        tween(glow, out, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    end
    task.delay(0.3, function()
        pcall(function()
            screenGui:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end
handle = { Close = close }
environment[LOCK_KEY] = handle

local function writeClipboard(text)
    local writer = (typeof(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard)
        or (typeof(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard)
        or (type(Clipboard) == "table" and typeof(Clipboard.set) == "function" and Clipboard.set)
        or nil
    if not writer then
        return false
    end
    return (pcall(writer, text))
end

local copyToken = 0
local function restoreCopy(token)
    task.delay(1.8, function()
        if closed or token ~= copyToken then
            return
        end
        copyLabel.Text = "Copy Link"
        copyGradient.Color = sequence({ { 0, COLORS.BlurpleLight }, { 1, COLORS.Blurple } })
        tween(fieldStroke, quick(0.25), { Color = COLORS.FieldStroke })
        linkBox.Text = INVITE_TEXT
    end)
end

local hovering = false
table.insert(connections, copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    hovering = true
    tween(copyScale, quick(0.15), { Scale = 1.04 })
end))
table.insert(connections, copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    hovering = false
    tween(copyScale, quick(0.15), { Scale = 1 })
end))
table.insert(connections, copyButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    tween(copyScale, quick(0.08), { Scale = 0.95 })
end))
table.insert(connections, copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    copyToken += 1
    local token = copyToken
    copyScale.Scale = 0.92
    tween(copyScale, quick(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = hovering and 1.04 or 1 })
    if writeClipboard(INVITE_URL) then
        copyLabel.Text = "✓  Copied!"
        copyGradient.Color = sequence({ { 0, COLORS.SuccessLight }, { 1, COLORS.Success } })
        tween(fieldStroke, quick(0.2), { Color = COLORS.Success })
    else
        copyLabel.Text = "Select & Copy"
        linkBox.Text = INVITE_URL
        pcall(function()
            linkBox:CaptureFocus()
            linkBox.SelectionStart = 1
            linkBox.CursorPosition = #INVITE_URL + 1
        end)
        tween(fieldStroke, quick(0.2), { Color = COLORS.Ember })
    end
    shine.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.4, 0.5)
    tween(shine, quick(0.45), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.4, 0.5) })
    restoreCopy(token)
end))

    local elapsed = os.clock() - started
    borderGradient.Rotation = (elapsed * 60) % 360
    logo.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, math.sin(elapsed * 1.6) * 2.5)
    local pulse = (elapsed * 0.9) % 1
    liveHalo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8 + pulse * 10, 8 + pulse * 10)
    liveHalo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + pulse * 0.55
    topLineGradient.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(elapsed * 0.8) * 0.25, 0)
    blobBlue.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20 + math.sin(elapsed * 0.6) * 16, 0, 6 + math.cos(elapsed * 0.5) * 12)
    blobRed.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16 + math.cos(elapsed * 0.55) * 14, 1, -4 + math.sin(elapsed * 0.7) * 10)
end))

        task.wait(2.6)

end)
